text:
Clara J: Heads up  had to extend a business trip unexpectedly due to a family medical emergency. Booked two extra nights on the same hotel folio (personal portion), rebooked return flight at a higher fare on my personal card, and the corporate card shows a lounge charge that I don't recognize. Also withdrew local cash and lost one small receipt. What is the cleanest way to file this so Finance can separate company vs personal charges?
Mia (People Ops): Sorry to hear that Clara  hope everyone is okay. Short checklist: 1) Upload the full hotel folio and include an allocation note showing which nights are business vs personal. 2) For the rebooked return flight, attach the e-ticket, card screenshot, and a short attestation explaining why you booked personally (medical extension). 3) Lodge a dispute ticket for the lounge charge if you believe it's fraud, but still upload the lounge invoice and mark it as disputed. 4) For the lost small receipt, use the lost-receipt attestation with manager approval.
Clara J: For the allocation note  is a one-line text file OK, or should I ask the hotel to reissue separate invoices?
Finance Ops Bot: A one-line allocation note is acceptable if it clearly shows dates and amounts to be reimbursed. Preferred: YYYYMMDD_hotel_allocation_amount_currency (e.g., 20270210_Hilton_alloc_240USD). If you can get the hotel to split invoice, that speeds VAT recovery, but not required.
Omar R (Manager): I approved the business nights when Clara called me. Omar R (manager). I'll also add a comment in the expense workflow to fast-track given it's a medical emergency.
Clara J: For the rebooked flight I paid higher fare because direct flights were only available last minute. Do you need a doctor's note? I don't want to share medical details.
Mia (People Ops): We do not require detailed medical records. Upload a short attestation (see template) and manager approval is sufficient for reimbursement of necessary changes. If the amount is large (> $1,000) People Ops may request a brief confirmation email but not detailed medical files.

```
Flight change attestation
Employee: Clara J
Date: 2027-02-14
Expense: Return flight rebook (personal card)
Amount: $642.00
Reason: Family medical emergency required extension of stay; manager approved
Manager approver: Omar R
```

Clara J: The lounge charge on the corporate card looks like it posted while I was in transit but I didn't use that lounge. What should I do?
Travel Desk Bot: File a dispute with the card provider via the corporate card portal and attach the lounge invoice to the dispute. In parallel, upload the lounge invoice to the expense report and mark it as "disputed" so Finance knows to hold reimbursement until dispute resolves.
Clara J: Lost one taxi receipt (~9 EUR) and one small coffee receipt (~4 EUR)  both in cash. I have bank screenshot for the bigger taxi but not the coffee.
Mia (People Ops): For small cash items under 15 you may use an attestation + manager approval. Attach the bank screenshot for the taxi and use this short template for the coffee attestation.

```
Lost receipt attestation
Employee: Clara J
Date: 2027-02-13
Vendor: Local cafe
Amount: 4.00 EUR
Reason: receipt misplaced during emergency; manager approved
Manager approver: Omar R
```

Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: choose one method per trip (itemized receipts vs per-diem). Since you have multiple itemized claims, submit itemized items. For multi-currency claims, upload originals and the system will convert at submission.
Clara J: Any naming rules so Finance doesn't ask for follow-ups?
Mia (People Ops): Use: YYYYMMDD_city_vendor_amount_currency[_attest/_VAT/_disputed]. Examples: 20270212_London_Hilton_alloc_480GBP, 20270214_Rebook_Airline_642USD_attest, 20270213_Cafe_attest_4EUR_attest.
Clara J: Thanks I'll upload now and tag @Omar for the manager sign-off in the expense system. Appreciate the quick guidance. :heart:
Mia (People Ops): Sending support  ping us if you want People Ops to pre-check the report before submission.
Finance Ops Bot: Note: receipts older than 60 days require an exception. Flag "expenses-late" and include a reason.
Omar R (Manager): Approved. Adding a manager note to the claim to expedite review.
